purpose: Daily Execution Backtest phase C: test position count, equal-slot concentration and initial-stop risk budgeting while holding the V1.7A NEXT_OPEN entry and V1.7B MA5/MA10 death-cross exit fixed.

researchPolicy.fixedSignalRiskRegime: MA5 rising-cross signal + 1.25 ATR/prior-10-day-low initial stop + NO_BEAR + five-session post-stop cooldown.
researchPolicy.validation: 2025 historical secondary evidence; no longer pristine.
researchPolicy.ranking: Rank by min(2024 total return, 2025 total return); drawdown and utilization are reported separately.

sizingRules.EQUAL_SLOT: Target one equal portfolio slot per position; unused slots remain cash.
sizingRules.INITIAL_STOP_RISK: Target a fixed percentage of current portfolio equity lost if the initial stop is hit, capped at 20% portfolio weight per name; actual realized gap-through loss can exceed the planned risk.
sizingRules.selectionPriority: When candidates compete for capacity, higher MA5 slope first, then higher signal-day trade value, then symbol.
sizingRules.cash: No leverage; allocations are capped by available cash.

limitations: This phase changes portfolio sizing/capacity only; the candidate signal, entry, stop, cooldown and exit are fixed.
Portfolio sizing chronology intentionally matches V1.7A/B for strict baseline parity; a separate chronology audit should test prior-close/open-equity sizing before production promotion.
Risk-budget sizing uses the modeled opening fill and initial stop distance; a live market-on-open implementation would need a pre-open price proxy or post-open sizing.
No sector-concentration cap is applied in V1.7C; sector risk should be tested separately rather than mixed into this compact sizing experiment.
Survivorship bias and frozen Yahoo-source limitations remain; forward Decision Ledger evidence remains required before production promotion.
